headline: Critical PHP Cyber-Security Vulnerabilities Trigger Global Warnings
summary: Critical vulnerabilities found in PHP, a widely used programming language, led to websites being taken down worldwide and prompted urgent security updates.
why: PHP underpins a vast portion of internet applications and web servers, making software vulnerabilities a systemic risk for digital infrastructure.

impacts.name: Software and Technology
impacts.why: Widespread code vulnerabilities require immediate patching across global web infrastructure, increasing operational risks for tech firms.
